name: LOLA south-polar terrain · de Gerlache Rim 1
spatial_relation: The candidate coordinate is a regional locator from the candidate catalogue, not a landing ellipse or rover traverse.
provider: NASA LRO LOLA / PDS Geosciences Node
observation_period: LOLA data acquired through 2017-02-02; PDS polar DEM product V2.1
coordinate_frame: Mean Earth / polar axis of DE421; planetocentric latitude; east-positive longitude
units: m relative to the LOLA 1,737.4 km reference sphere
observation_coverage: Paired LDEC product gives direct observation counts at 120 m. Output DEM cells are retained only when at least 25% of the contributing native grid is directly observed.
missing_data_semantics: LDEC count 0 means no direct LOLA observations contributed to that native cell; such cells are not used as elevation evidence.
uncertainty_note: Direct-shot counts describe support, not vertical uncertainty. The PDS product does not provide a per-cell elevation uncertainty layer; vertical error is not propagated.
processing_method: Only the selected 96×96 native-cell windows were fetched by verified HTTP byte-range requests; no whole polar raster was downloaded. DEM elevations were averaged to the 463.0577 m comparison grid after masking unsupported source cells.

uncertainty.description: Input DEM uncertainty not supplied by adapter

provenance.provider: NASA LRO LOLA / PDS Geosciences Node
provenance.processing_method: Bounded PDS3 HTTP range reads of the 120 m LDEM and paired LDEC shot-count products; elevation is DN × 0.5 m; direct-support fraction is averaged into the 463.0577 m comparison grid; cells below 25% are excluded.
